title: Bead Path Builder
shareTitle: Bead Path Builder — Fine Motor Patterns
description: Thread chunky painted wooden beads onto a curved cord, continue gentle AB and ABC patterns, or design a one-of-a-kind necklace.
learningGoals: Practice controlled placement on a path
Follow simple bead patterns with color and shape cues
interactionModel: drag a large wooden bead through the cord tip and into the next glowing position, or use the complete tap-bead then tap-slot fallback; free play supports left-to-right revision
feedbackModel: correct beads hop to the cord tip, slide home, and click; mismatches wobble with a gentle pattern cue; completed necklaces sparkle, speak praise, and unlock the fox Magic Mirror reward

modes.title: AB Garden
modes.skill: continue a two-part repeating pattern while placing left to right

modes.title: ABC Rainbow
modes.skill: continue a three-part repeating pattern while placing left to right

modes.title: My Necklace
modes.skill: plan, revise, and finish a self-chosen bead sequence
